questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the zstatements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All knifes are axes.

All axes are swords.

All saws are swords.

**Conclusions:**

I. All swords are knifes.

II. Some axes are saws.

III. No axe is saw.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Either conclusion II or III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Veen diagram is given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/804f1f772f05c7f57b1074c82e53e2e474ea5333190b3fdeb2a6d6b856efd8d0.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. All swords are knife → False (some swords are knives is true)

II. Some axes are saws → False (It is possible but not definite).

III. No axe is saw → False (It is possible but not definite).

So, conclusion II and III are complementary to each other.

Hence, the correct answer is Either conclusion II or III follows.

questions.question:

questions.question: If it was a Friday on 1 January 2016, what was the day of the week on 31 December 2016?
questions.solution:
2016 is a leap year so we get an extra odd day with respect to the ordinary year. So we get one extra day.

Therefore, the day will be Friday + 1 = Saturday.

Hence, the correct answer is Saturday.

questions.question: If CAT is coded as 72 and TROT is coded as 292, then how will STAG be coded as?
questions.solution:
The sum of the positional value of CAT = 3 + 1 + 20 = 24 and 24 × 3 (Number of letters) = 72 

Also,

TROT = 20 + 18 + 15 + 20 = 73 and 73 × 4 (Number of letters) = 292

So, the code for

The sum of the positional value of STAG = 19 + 20 + 1 + 7 = 47 and 47 × 4 (Number of letter) = 188

Hence, the correct answer is 188.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(45, 49, 47)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is,

(45, 49, 47) → **45 + 49** = 94 ÷ 2 = **47**

Similarly,

(35, 59, 47) → **35 + 59** = 94 ÷ 2 = **47**

Hence, (35, 59, 47) is the correct answer.

42 : 56
questions.solution:
Given series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/332d03ba80104fd9a3e7dba3bc3a760a9b0b48be327008cb3af919df39c75bf0.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The logic followed here is:

For, 

42 : 56

→ 62 + 6 = 42.

→ 72 + 7 = 56.

Similarly, for 12 : 20

→ 32 + 3 = 12.

→ 42 + 4 = 20.

Hence, the correct answer is '12 : 20'.
